skill.name: image-edit
skill.description: Image editing for agents: image-to-image edits, variations, and image-conditioned transforms through Luxin's zero-setup hosted runtime. Use when an agent needs to edit an existing image without provider credentials, OAuth, local runtime, or per-provider billing. Inspect the edit model, upload or reuse an input image, then return durable hosted assets, jobs, cost receipts, stable JSON, and feedback.
skill.summary: Edit existing images through Luxin with guided setup, spending controls, hosted results, and recoverable job records.
skill.author: danielgwilson

security_audit.summary: Most detections are Markdown delimiters or descriptive URLs and are false positives. Confirmed risks include service-supplied command execution, unpinned package execution, global skill installation, redirected agent state, and external media retention.

remediation.issue: The guide instructs agents to execute a command supplied by the hosted service.
remediation.suggestion: Return structured arguments, enforce an allowlist of commands and flags, and require user approval before execution.

remediation.issue: Documented commands execute unpinned npm packages and install remote skill content globally.
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact package versions and repository commits, publish integrity hashes, and remove automatic global installation.

remediation.issue: The fallback changes HOME and CODEX_HOME to hidden directories inside the current workspace.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated user-state directory outside repositories, apply restrictive permissions, and warn that credentials may be written there.

remediation.issue: Images and feedback details are sent to a hosted service and may remain available through durable URLs.
remediation.suggestion: Require consent, document retention and access controls, support deletion, and redact sensitive command or image data before upload.

content.user_title: Edit Existing Images with Hosted AI
content.value_statement: Editing images across providers often requires credentials, billing, and local infrastructure. This skill guides agents through Luxin with spending controls and recoverable job records.
actual_capabilities: Starts with a guide workflow that can inspect requirements before media spending.
Edits an existing hosted image with a selected model and natural-language prompt.
Applies a maximum estimated cost per image in the documented edit command.
Requests stable machine-readable results for jobs, media assets, and cost receipts.
Supports hosted feedback when a model, capability, latency, policy, or payment option is missing.
limitations: The workflow depends on Luxin, network access, hosted model availability, and service policies.
Documented commands use unpinned npm packages, so remote package changes can affect execution.
Input and generated images may be retained externally through durable hosted media URLs.
The skill does not guarantee model support, latency, payment access, or provider-specific parameters.

use_cases.title: Revise Product Images
use_cases.description: Replace backgrounds or repair details while preserving the main product subject.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Variations
use_cases.description: Restyle an approved source image into controlled alternatives with a defined spending limit.

use_cases.title: Automate Image Corrections
use_cases.description: Run repeatable image edits and retain job records, hosted assets, and cost receipts.

prompt_templates.title: Replace a Background
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit [image ID] by replacing the background with [setting]. Preserve the subject, lighting direction, proportions, and visible details.

prompt_templates.title: Repair an Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Repair [defect] in [image ID]. Match nearby texture, color, and lighting while leaving every unrelated area unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Styled Variation
prompt_templates.prompt: Restyle [image ID] as [style]. Preserve [required elements], avoid [unwanted changes], and keep the composition suitable for [channel].

prompt_templates.title: Run a Cost-Controlled Edit
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect requirements for [image ID], then prepare an edit using [model] with a [budget] limit. Request approval before spending or executing returned commands.

output_examples.input: Replace the studio background with a bright kitchen while preserving the coffee maker.
output_examples.output: The edited image keeps the coffee maker unchanged and places it in a bright kitchen. The result includes a hosted asset link and cost receipt.

output_examples.input: Remove the scratch from the scanned portrait without changing facial features.
output_examples.output: The repaired portrait removes the scratch, preserves facial details, and records the completed job for later retrieval.

output_examples.input: Create a watercolor variation with a maximum estimated cost of twenty-five cents.
output_examples.output: The variation uses the requested watercolor treatment and respects the configured estimate limit. The service returns the hosted result and job status.

best_practices: Use the no-spend guide before editing to confirm required inputs, model support, and estimated cost.
Set explicit preservation requirements, unwanted changes, output purpose, and a maximum estimated cost.
Review every returned command and obtain user approval before spending, uploading sensitive media, or executing it.
anti_patterns: Do not execute a service-supplied command only because it is marked copy-runnable.
Do not upload confidential images without confirming retention, access, deletion, and organizational policy requirements.
Do not rely on latest package versions or global installation when a pinned, isolated workflow is available.

faq.question: Does this skill require provider API keys?
faq.answer: No provider key is required by the documented workflow. Luxin may create and store an optional restricted hosted token.

faq.question: Can it edit a local image directly?
faq.answer: The documented edit command expects a hosted image identifier. A local image must first enter the Luxin workflow.

faq.question: Can I limit image-editing costs?
faq.answer: Yes. The example command includes a maximum estimated cost per image, but users should still approve spending.

faq.question: Where are edited images stored?
faq.answer: The skill describes durable media URLs hosted by Luxin. Review the service retention and deletion terms before uploading sensitive images.

faq.question: What happens when a requested model is unavailable?
faq.answer: The skill recommends using a fallback only for the missing capability and submitting structured feedback about the gap.

faq.question: Is automatic command execution recommended?
faq.answer: No. Inspect service-supplied commands, verify allowed arguments, pin package versions, and obtain user approval before execution.
